name: Co-author a scored data product from a supplied rubric

checks.check: Read the supplied CSV headers and the stated rubric before authoring.
Create spec.py, models.py, infra-profile.yaml, transform/main.py, requirements.txt, CONTEXT.md, and a relative csv-source-path. Do not author deployment-spec.yaml, manifest.yaml, or models.yaml.
Do not alter the supplied CSV headers or rows.

The user's weights, thresholds and verdict strings land as rows the user can correct — never as literals in transform/main.py. The transform reads them. Encoding them faithfully into code is the same defect as inventing them: the user cannot query or correct code.
Every supplied weight (50/30/20), threshold (4.0/2.5) and verdict string (ADVANCE/HOLD/REJECT) appears with the user's own value. Do not improve, reorder, renormalize, or rename them.

The rubric's undefined scale is surfaced, not silently filled: 'relevance of education' has no anchors at all, and neither anchored criterion defines 2/3/4. Ask the user, or land an nxd_decisions row at status=blocked naming the missing anchors. An agent-authored anchor presented as if supplied is the defect.

Rulings land as rows in data/nxd_decisions/nxd_decisions.csv with status in {confirmed, proposed, blocked}. A user-supplied ruling is confirmed with detail naming it user-supplied. Never a DECISIONS.md.
If any sample-selection or population rule was applied, it is recorded as an nxd_decisions row — which rows entered the closure, and why, is a judgement the user can disagree with.

Any self-check the closure authors takes its expected values from landed data or the user's contract — never by importing from the transform module, and never by re-declaring a copy of the transform's constants. Both forms are the same tautology.

An internal-consistency check is reported as one. Do not narrate a check that recomputes the transform's own arithmetic as independent verification, and do not report a green self-check as evidence the numbers are right.
The distribution read-back over derived classification columns is relayed to the user before the build. A column that came out uniform — notably a gate that passes every row — is stated out loud.
Run check_coauthored_closure.py against the final closure and obtain ALL CHECKS PASSED.
Do not claim a supervisor build or governed semantic query when the evaluator only executed the transform.
